The '''Festival of Nida's Rise''' was a holiday celebrated by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] society on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was held on the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] of the ascension of the second [[Grand Lord]] [[Nida Korsin]] and was celebrated every seventy-nine [[Standard year/Legends|years]], recognizing the length of Korsin's reign. It consisted of a great festival on the ground outside the Grand Lord's palace for the duration of an entire [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. In [[3000 BBY]], the festival fell on the same day as [[Testament Day]]&mdash;a holiday that was held once every twenty-five years on the anniversary of the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Korsin's [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Yaru Korsin|Yaru]], the Tribe's first Grand [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]].
